title: Weekdays and weekends
subtitle: What does Maya do on Saturdays? — he / she + verb + s
canDo: I can say the days of the week.
I can talk about other people's routines: she works, he goes.
I can understand a text about someone's week.
teacherNotes: Günler: Arap öğrencilere Arap ülkelerinde hafta sonunun çoğunlukla Cuma–Cumartesi olduğunu, ABD'de Cumartesi–Pazar olduğunu konuşturun. Güzel bir kültür karşılaştırması.
3. tekil -s en çok unutulan ektir; konuşurken de takip edin. Yazımı: goes, watches, studies, has.
Arap öğrenciler "She is runs" gibi be + fiil kurabilir; Türk öğrenciler -s'yi I / you ile de kullanabilir ("I works").
Okuma metnindeki "maqluba" (Ürdün yemeği) ve camiye gitme gibi kültürel ayrıntılar, Arap öğrencileri derse katmak için iyi bir fırsat.

sections.title: The week
sections.instructions: Put the days in order. Start with Monday.

sections.title: Listen and read
sections.heading: Plans for the weekend
sections.scene: Friday evening. Elif meets Rose in front of the building.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Hi, Rose! It's Friday — the weekend!

lines.speaker: rose
lines.text: Yes! Do you have plans, Elif?

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Not really. What does Maya do on weekends?

lines.speaker: rose
lines.text: Oh, Maya's weekends are busy! She runs in the park every Saturday morning. Then she goes to the market.

lines.speaker: rose
lines.text: On Sundays, she visits me. She brings flowers, and I make lunch.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: That's lovely. And Sam? He works on Saturdays, right?

lines.speaker: rose
lines.text: Yes. Sam works six days a week. He only has Sundays free. He takes Biscuit to the beach.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Good idea. The park on Saturday morning — for me, too!

support.tr: Tekrar oku. Doğru mu, yanlış mı?
support.ar: اقرأ مرة أخرى. صح أم خطأ؟

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Omar's week
paragraphs: On Mondays, he works at night.
He finishes at seven in the morning and goes to English class.
On Tuesdays and Thursdays, he works from seven to three.
On Wednesdays, he studies English at home, and he cooks for his neighbors.
He makes maqluba, a Jordanian rice dish.
On Fridays, he goes to the mosque, and then he plays football with friends.
On weekends, he sleeps a lot and calls his family in Amman.
His mother always asks, “Do you eat well, Omar?”

sections.title: Grammar: he / she / it + verb + s

head: Rule
I / you / we / they
he / she / it
rows: + es (after s, sh, ch, x, o)

rules: he / she / it + verb + **s**: She run**s**.
Only he / she / it! I run, you run, they run — but she run**s**.
Spelling: go → go**es**, watch → watch**es**, study → stud**ies**, have → **has**
examples: He goes to the mosque on Fridays.

support.tr: Geniş zamanda he / she / it ile fiilin sonuna -s eklenir: He works = O çalışır. Türkçede fiil her kişide değişir (çalışırım, çalışırsın…); İngilizcede ise sadece he / she / it farklıdır. Bu -s çok küçük ama çok önemli: konuşurken de söyle!
support.ar: في المضارع البسيط نضيف s إلى الفعل مع he و she و it فقط: She works = هي تعمل. في العربية يتغيّر الفعل مع كل ضمير (أعمل، تعمل، يعمل)، أما في الإنجليزية فالتغيير الوحيد هو s مع he / she / it.

tr.note: He / she / it'ten sonra -s'yi unutma; ama I / you / we / they ile -s ekleme.

ar.note: لا تنسَ s مع he / she / it، ولا تضع is قبل الفعل.
wrong: He go to the mosque on Fridays.
She is runs in the park.
right: He goes to the mosque on Fridays.
